content: Can you recommend any vegetarian dishes to try in Bangkok?

Sure, here are some vegetarian dishes to try in Bangkok:

1. Pad Thai Jay - A vegetarian version of Thailand's most famous dish, made with tofu or vegetables instead of meat.

2. Tom Yum Mushroom - Spicy and sour soup with mushroom and herbs.

3. Pak Boong Fai Daeng - Stir-fried morning glory with garlic and chili.

4. Khao Pad Jay - Vegetarian fried rice with vegetables and tofu.

5. Gaeng Kiew Wan Jay - Green curry with vegetables and tofu.

6. Som Tum Jay - Spicy papaya salad with peanuts and vegetables.

7. Pad Pak Ruam - Stir-fried mixed vegetables with oyster sauce.

8. Massaman Jay - Muslim-style curry with vegetables and tofu.

9. Tom Kha Hed - Coconut milk soup with mushroom and herbs.

10. Kao Soi Jay - Northern-style curry noodle soup with tofu or vegetables.
These sound really good! Do you have any recommendations for specific restaurants that serve great vegetarian food in Bangkok?

Yes, here are some vegetarian-friendly restaurants in Bangkok to check out:

1. May Veggie Home - Known for their vegan sushi and Thai dishes made with plant-based meat substitutes.

2. Ethos Vegetarian and Vegan Restaurant - Offers a range of vegetarian and vegan choices, including international dishes and Thai classics.

3. Veganerie Concept - A popular vegan bakery that serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner items, as well as desserts.

4. Broccoli Revolution - Serves vegetarian and vegan cuisine that focuses on using fresh, locally-sourced produce.

5. Sustaina - A vegan restaurant that offers a mix of Asian and Western dishes made with organic ingredients.

6. Rasayana Retreat - A health-conscious restaurant that offers raw and vegan meals, as well as detox juices and smoothies.

7. Koko Be Organics - A cafe that serves plant-based meals made with organic ingredients, including vegan burgers and raw desserts.

8. Bonita Cafe and Social Club - A vegetarian cafe that offers plenty of meat-free options, including sandwiches, salads, and smoothies. 

9. May Kaidee's Vegetarian - A long-standing vegetarian restaurant, offering delicious Thai dishes such as Tom Yum soup and Pad Thai.

10. Chu Chocolate Bar and Cafe - A vegan cafe that serves healthful yet indulgent options, such as smoothies, salads, sandwiches, and an array of vegan chocolates.
Wow, these all sound amazing! I think I'll have to try May Veggie Home and Veganerie Concept for sure.
Those are great choices. Enjoy your vegetarian food adventure in Bangkok!

9. Broccoli Revolution - Offers vegan sweet treats, including vegan banana bread and vegan chocolate mousse.
